text: The Mouwasat hospitals network in the kingdom's major cities is the network of Mouwasat Medical Services Company, as stated on the group's own corporate site.
short: The Mouwasat hospital network belongs to Mouwasat Medical Services Company

source.name: Mouwasat Medical Services: Shareholders & Major Client (corporate site)
source.quote: Mouwasat Medical Services company is honored of its hospitals’ network in the kingdom's major cities to provide its medical services
source.note: Company site of the hospital group (the club's partner logo on ettifaq.com links to mouwasat.com). Same page: 'For details of the company's major shareholders, please refer to TADAWUL'.
